sentences.en: The flood was the greatest disaster they had ever had.
sentences.zh: 那场洪水是他们经历过的最严重的灾难。

sentences.en: The Red Cross gets help to disaster victims without delay.
sentences.zh: 红十字会迅速向受灾群众提供援助。

sentences.en: If the hay caught fire, it would be a real disaster.
sentences.zh: 如果干草着火了，那将是一场真正的灾难。

senses.zh: 灾难，灾害；祸患，灾难性事物；彻底的失败
